                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ভর্তি করার সময় = 6 min

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        খালি করার সময় = 12 min

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        প্রয়োজনীয় কাজ = ট্যাঙ্কের 1/4 অংশ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        কাজ = প্রদত্ত সময়ের ল.সা.গু (LCM)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        হার = কাজ ÷ সময়

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        সময় = কাজ ÷ মোট হার

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 6 এবং 12 এর ল.সা.গু (LCM) = 12

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ভর্তি করার পাইপের হার = 12 ÷ 6 = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ খালি করার পাইপের হার = 12 ÷ 12 = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ মোট হার = 2 − 1 = 1

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ সম্পূর্ণ ট্যাঙ্ক ভর্তি করার সময় = 12 ÷ 1 = 12

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ট্যাঙ্কের 1/4 অংশ ভর্তি করার সময় = 12 ÷ 4 = 3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ সঠিক উত্তরটি হল 3 minutes।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ભરવા માટેનો સમય = 6 min

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ખાલી કરવા માટેનો સમય = 12 min

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ભરતી પાઇપનો દર = 12 ÷ 6 = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Marked price = 151% of cost price

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Discount = 8%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Selling price = Marked price × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Profit% = [(Selling price − Cost price) ÷ Cost price] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Let cost price = 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Marked price = 151

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Selling price = 151 × 92 ÷ 100 = 138.92

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Profit = 138.92 − 100 = 38.92

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Profit% = (38.92 ÷ 100) × 100 = 38.92%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Rounded value = 38.9%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 38.9%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        अंकित मूल्य = क्रय मूल्य का 151%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        छूट = 8%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        विक्रय मूल्य = अंकित मूल्य × (100 − छूट%) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        लाभ% = [(विक्रय मूल्य − क्रय मूल्य) ÷ क्रय मूल्य] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ माना, क्रय मूल्य = 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ अंकित मूल्य = 151

"correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Speed of first person = 5.4 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Speed of second person = 18 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Time = 30 sec and 44 sec

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Relative speed = (Train speed - Person speed)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Distance = Speed × Time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Let speed of train = x m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 5.4 km/hr = 1.5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 18 km/hr = 5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Train length = (x - 1.5) × 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Train length = (x - 5) × 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x - 1.5) × 30 = (x - 5) × 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 30x - 45 = 44x - 220

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 220 - 45 = 44x - 30x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 175 = 14x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 12.5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Speed in km/hr = 12.5 × 18/5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ Speed = 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ The correct answer is 45 km/hr.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        पहले व्यक्ति की चाल = 5.4 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दूसरे व्यक्ति की चाल = 18 किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        समय = 30 सेकंड और 44 सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        सापेक्ष चाल = (ट्रेन की चाल - व्यक्ति की चाल)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        दूरी = चाल × समय

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ माना, ट्रेन की चाल = x मीटर/सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 5.4 किमी/घंटा = 1.5 मीटर/सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 18 किमी/घंटा = 5 मीटर/सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ट्रेन की लंबाई = (x - 1.5) x 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ट्रेन की लंबाई = (x - 5) × 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x - 1.5) × 30 = (x - 5) × 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 30x - 45 = 44x - 220

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 220 - 45 = 44x - 30x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 175 = 14x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 12.5 मीटर/सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ किमी/घंटा में चाल = 12.5 × 18/5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ चाल = 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ सही उत्तर 45 किमी/घंटा है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        2 men work for 5 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Remaining time = 9 days

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Work = LCM method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Rate = Work ÷ Time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒\n Let LCM work = 18

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఇవ్వబడినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        మొదటి వ్యక్తి వేగం = 5.4 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        రెండవ వ్యక్తి వేగం = 18 km/hr

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సమయం = 30 sec మరియు 44 sec

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        సాపేక్ష వేగం = (రైలు వేగం - వ్యక్తి వేగం)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        దూరం = వేగం × సమయం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ రైలు వేగం = x m/s అనుకుందాం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 5.4 km/hr = 1.5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 18 km/hr = 5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ రైలు పొడవు = (x - 1.5) × 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਸਾਪੇਖਿਕ ਗਤੀ = (ਰੇਲਗੱਡੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ - ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਦੂਰੀ = ਗਤੀ × ਸਮਾਂ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਮੰਨ ਲਓ ਰੇਲਗੱਡੀ ਦੀ ਗਤੀ = x m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 5.4 km/hr = 1.5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 18 km/hr = 5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਰੇਲਗੱਡੀ ਦੀ ਲੰਬਾਈ = (x - 1.5) × 30

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਰੇਲਗੱਡੀ ਦੀ ਲੰਬਾਈ = (x - 5) × 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ (x - 1.5) × 30 = (x - 5) × 44

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 30x - 45 = 44x - 220

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 220 - 45 = 44x - 30x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ 175 = 14x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ x = 12.5 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ km/hr ਵਿੱਚ ਗਤੀ = 12.5 × 18/5

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ⇒ ਗਤੀ = 45

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ∴ ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ 45 km/hr ਹੈ।
