                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ਪੌਦੇ ਲਗਾਉਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੁਹਿੰਮਾਂ, ਹਰਿਆਵਲ ਨੂੰ ਵਧਾਉਣਾ, ਅਤੇ ਰਿਫਲੈਕਟਿਵ ਬਿਲਡਿੰਗ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕਰਨਾ ਸ਼ਹਿਰੀ ਹੀਟ ਆਈਲੈਂਡ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਲੰਬੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਰਣਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ਸਰਵੇਖਣ ਵਿਧੀ (Survey Methodology): Yale ਅਤੇ CVoter ਦੁਆਰਾ ਕੀਤੇ ਗਏ ਸਰਵੇਖਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਾਰਤੀ ਆਬਾਦੀ ਦੇ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਨਿਧ ਨਮੂਨੇ ਤੋਂ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਰੈਂਡਮ ਸੈਂਪਲਿੰਗ ਤਕਨੀਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਗਈ ਸੀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ਜਲਵਾਯੂ ਜਾਗਰੂਕਤਾ (Climate Awareness): ਸਰਵੇਖਣ ਦਾ ਉਦੇਸ਼ ਜਲਵਾਯੂ ਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਨਤਕ ਜਾਗਰੂਕਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਨਵਿਆਉਣਯੋਗ ਊਰਜਾ ਅਪਣਾਉਣ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਰਬਨ ਘਟਾਉਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਪਹਿਲਕਦਮੀਆਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਉਪਾਵਾਂ ਲਈ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਮਰਥਨ ਦਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਕਰਨਾ ਵੀ ਸੀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ਗਲੋਬਲ ਸੰਦਰਭ (Global Context): ਲੂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਭਾਰਤ ਤੱਕ ਹੀ ਸੀਮਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ; ਇਹ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਵਵਿਆਪੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਯੂਰਪ, ਆਸਟ੍ਰੇਲੀਆ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਤਰੀ ਅਮਰੀਕਾ ਵਰਗੇ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਹਾਲ ਹੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਤੋੜ ਤਾਪਮਾਨ ਦਰਜ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ਨੀਤੀਗਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ (Policy Implications): ਅਜਿਹੇ ਸਰਵੇਖਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਜਲਵਾਯੂ ਨੀਤੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੂਚਿਤ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਆਫ਼ਤ-ਰੋਧਕ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲਈ ਮਹੱਤਵਪੂਰਨ ਹਨ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n262:T16a5,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The C40 World Mayors Summit is a global event where mayors from various cities come together to discuss climate change, urban sustainability, and environmental policies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The 2025 C40 World Mayors Summit is scheduled to be held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil from 3-5 November 2025.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Rio de Janeiro, a prominent city in Brazil, is renowned for its efforts in addressing urban challenges, including its initiatives related to climate resilience and sustainable urban development.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The summit provides a platform for global leaders, climate experts, and city officials to collaborate and share innovative strategies to combat climate change.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • About the C40 Cities Climate Leadership Group:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • C40 is a network of nearly 100 cities worldwide committed to addressing climate change and promoting sustainable urban living.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It was established in 2005 and focuses on reducing greenhouse gas emissions and improving city-wide sustainability.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • C40 cities represent over 700 million citizens and one-quarter of the global economy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Rio de Janeiro's Climate Initiatives:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Rio de Janeiro has implemented policies like urban reforestation and the development of green infrastructure to mitigate the impacts of climate change.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The city has been recognized for its efforts in creating resilient infrastructure to tackle challenges like flooding and rising sea levels.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Rio is also a member of the C40 network, actively participating in global climate discussions and initiatives.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Purpose of the C40 World Mayors Summit:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The summit aims to accelerate efforts to meet the goals of the Paris Agreement and to limit global warming to 1.5°C.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • India's First Biological Experiments Aboard ISS: In May 2025, India announced its plan to conduct biological experiments aboard the International Space Station (ISS). This marks a significant milestone in India's space exploration journey.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Objective: The experiments aim to study the sustainability of human life in space, focusing on biological processes, adaptability, and the potential for long-term space habitation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Policy Initiative: The initiative is part of the BioE3 Biotechnology policy, which emphasizes leveraging biotechnology for advancements in space exploration, health sciences, and sustainability.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Collaborations: The project aligns with global partnerships and cooperation in space research, contributing to India's efforts in enhancing its technological capabilities in space and biotechnology.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Strategic Importance: This experiment not only reinforces India's presence in the global space community but also highlights its commitment to scientific innovation and addressing challenges related to space sustainability.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • BioE3 Biotechnology Policy:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Launched as part of India's vision for leveraging biotechnology in critical sectors, including space research.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Focuses on fostering innovation, promoting interdisciplinary research, and encouraging collaboration between government agencies, research institutions, and private enterprises.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Supports initiatives aimed at addressing global challenges, such as sustainable development and space exploration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • International Space Station (ISS):\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The ISS is a collaborative space station involving NASA, Roscosmos, ESA, JAXA, and CSA.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It serves as a hub for conducting scientific research in microgravity environments, including biological, physical, and astronomical studies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India's involvement in ISS-related experiments showcases its growing expertise and ambition in space exploration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Sustainability of Human Life in Space:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Studying biological adaptability in space is crucial for understanding the effects of microgravity, radiation, and isolation on human health.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • These studies contribute to the development of technologies and strategies for long-term space missions and potential colonization efforts.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • India's Space Achievements:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India has made remarkable progress in space technology, with missions like Chandrayaan, Mangalyaan, and the Gaganyaan program.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • This biological experiment reinforces India's position as a key player in the global space community.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Important Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Biotechnology in Space Research:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Biotechnology plays a vital role in addressing challenges related to health, sustainability, and adaptability during space missions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Experiments aboard the ISS help develop solutions for space food production, regenerative medicine, and human survival in extreme environments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Global Impact:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • India's involvement in ISS experiments underscores its commitment to contributing to international scientific collaboration.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Findings from these studies have implications not only for space exploration but also for earth-based applications in biotechnology and medicine.
